title: Model Evaluation & Validation
description: Go beyond accuracy: choose the right metrics for classification and regression tasks, design cross-validation correctly for different data types, understand AUC-ROC and model calibration, and avoid the evaluation pitfalls — leakage from preprocessing, shuffled time-series splits, and SMOTE applied before splitting — that inflate validation scores.
outcomes: You'll select the right classification and regression metric for a given business context, design a cross-validation strategy for IID and time-series data, explain what AUC-ROC measures and why it is threshold-agnostic, interpret a calibration curve and apply Platt scaling or isotonic regression to fix miscalibration, and identify preprocessing leakage from PCA, StandardScaler, and SMOTE applied before splitting.
